body:
Removesthe backwards-compatibility shims left behind by the DataLayouts, Geometry and Operators rewrites. Three of them were still in use here. 

## Deprectated name updates

**`MatrixFields.⋅` → `*`** — 18 operator uses in `energy_hydrology.jl`, `Biogeochemistry.jl` and `rre.jl`. `⋅` is no longer exported by `MatrixFields` in v0.16, so the four `import ClimaCore.MatrixFields: @name, ⋅` lines now import only `@name` (two of them never used the operator). `*` has denoted matrix multiplication since ClimaCore v0.14.27.

**`ClimaCore.RecursiveApply.rzero(T)` → `zero(T, space)`** — `ClimaLand.jl`, `models.jl` and `Canopy.jl`. The whole `RecursiveApply` module was a compatibility layer over the `AutoBroadcaster` wrappers added in v0.14.52.  The two `models.jl` docstrings that told implementers to define `rzero` now describe the `zero` requirement instead.

`Operators.WeakDivergence` -> `Operators.Divergence{Operators.WeakForm}`

title: Replace deprecated ClimaCore names removed in ClimaCore v0.16
